stem.zh-CN: 下列关于 [[term:resnet|ResNet]] 中的 [[term:residual-connection|shortcut connection]] 描述正确的是
stem.en-US: Which statements about the [[term:residual-connection|shortcut connection]] in [[term:resnet|ResNet]] are correct?

explanation.zh-CN: A、D 正确；B 表述过于绝对（[[term:identity-mapping|恒等映射]]尚不足以确保不退化）；C 错误，仅恒等映射也可起到稳定训练的作用，并非"必须有好处"才需参数。
explanation.en-US: A and D are correct. B is too absolute: an [[term:identity-mapping|identity mapping]] alone cannot guarantee that degradation will not occur. C is incorrect: an identity mapping can still help stabilize training, so parameters are not required only when they provide an obvious benefit.

secondaryEngineeringStages.zh-CN: E6 训练稳定性与调优

text.zh-CN: [[term:residual-connection|shortcut connection]] 有利于缓解深度神经网络的[[term:gradient-vanishing|梯度消失]]问题
text.en-US: A [[term:residual-connection|shortcut connection]] helps mitigate [[term:gradient-vanishing|vanishing gradients]] in deep neural networks

text.zh-CN: [[term:residual-connection|shortcut connection]] 让网络具备了[[term:identity-mapping|恒等映射]]能力，确保随着网络层数的增加，深层网络性能不会差于浅层网络性能
text.en-US: A [[term:residual-connection|shortcut connection]] gives the network an [[term:identity-mapping|identity mapping]], ensuring that a deeper network cannot perform worse than a shallower one as layers are added

text.zh-CN: [[term:residual-connection|shortcut connection]] 如果仅是一个 [[term:identity-mapping|identity mapping]] 的直接通路，相当于把输入直接传给输出，对神经网络不会有好处，所以必须在残差通路上添加参数
text.en-US: If a [[term:residual-connection|shortcut connection]] is only a direct [[term:identity-mapping|identity mapping]], it cannot benefit the neural network, so parameters must be added to the residual path

text.zh-CN: [[term:residual-connection|shortcut connection]] 应用广泛，在 [[term:mlp|MLP]]、[[term:cnn|CNN]]、[[term:rnn|RNN]] 等不同网络结构中均可添加
text.en-US: A [[term:residual-connection|shortcut connection]] is widely applicable and can be added to [[term:mlp|MLP]], [[term:cnn|CNN]], [[term:rnn|RNN]], and other network structures
